entries.field: aggregate[].concat_delta_mean_pp (>1 = criterion A), gain_mean_pp (>1 = criterion B); unified per_seed.rows[].{gain_pp,concat_delta_pp}
entries.checkpoint: submission: R5/R7 final? (see run_cross_purpose_attack_v2.py); cross-purpose model: canonical_iterate.pt (Diabetes best_epoch=0 per commit msg)
entries.note: 8/33 is a NEW model (cross-purpose-constrained h_concat training) scored under the incremental criterion; under the absolute criterion the same new model flags more cells with much larger magnitudes
entries.assessment: Submission 26/33 (A, absolute) and 22/33 (B, incremental) reproduce from aggregate.json; LAFTR 29/33 reproduces; LAFTR 16/33 only from DUAL_CRITERIA.json (laftr aggregate lacks gain field). 8/33 reproduces (B on a NEW cross-purpose-constrained model). Under criterion A the new model flags 19/33; all 11 LR cells go to exactly 0 (linear concat erasure), but on the 22 nonlinear cells absolute flags go 18->19 and absolute leakage rises in 20/22 cells (mean +19.4pp -> +24.2pp over majority). The local untracked comparison.json (pre-unified, absolute-vs-majority) gives 10/15+6/9+3/9 = 19/33. The 22/33->8/33 headline therefore swaps criteria-favourable framing: it compares incremental gains while single-purpose leakage itself increased. Also: paper Table 10 caption says gain over majority but values are gain over best single purpose (e.g. Adult age_group XGB +9.28 = gain; absolute is +20.0); +38.2pp marital_status quoted in text is the absolute XGB value (38.22).

entries.reported: R2<=0.005; 0.752+/-0.010; worst deltas -6.3 (Male), -8.2 (Young); trained<=init every cell
entries.checkpoint: final epoch (selector found 0 feasible epochs on all seeds)
entries.note: Table 12 deltas are max-over-attackers(trained) minus max-over-attackers(init), not cellwise; cellwise trained>init occurs. Val-split in-sample linear R2 at final epoch ~0.16 (fails tau). Cross-purpose 'R2' is linear R2 of attacker-predicted probabilities vs labels.
entries.assessment: Train-set R2 (0.0029-0.0036) and Smiling acc 0.7517+/-0.0103 (sample sd of last-epoch VAL accuracy) reproduce; Table 11 seed-0 values and Table 12 deltas reproduce. But Table 12 is max-over-attackers(trained) minus max-over-attackers(init); cellwise, trained > init on seed 0 Male MLP (+0.4pp) and seed 2 Male DeepMLP (+7.2pp), contradicting "trained <= LEACE-init at every cell ... without exception" (pdf23 lines 685-686, Table 11 caption). Val-split linear R2 at the final epoch is 0.156-0.170 on every seed and the selector found 0 feasible epochs; the paper reports only the train-set R2. Nonlinear attackers recover Male at R2 0.81-0.88 (MLP) from the trained representation.
